summary: SPX/NDX/DJI rallied ~1.1% on a dovish Fed pivot (Waller no-hike, Vance urging cuts) as yields fell and VIX dropped -5.79% to 14.32. Crypto led (IBIT +5.85% EXTREME, MSTR +17.56%, HOOD +16.57%) alongside software (SNOW +16.55% beat), while the chip rebound failed (AVGO -2.74%, CIEN -10.36%) and food staples were dumped. Regimes stayed Neutral Bull / RUT Neutral Bear with new 20day lows outnumbering new highs on all four indices - a powerful but unconfirmed bounce ahead of Friday jobs.
